top: Israel's vote count is done at 99.9 percent and still gives Netanyahu's bloc only 53 of 120 seats, with the Arab parties on 19 and holding the key.
Australian inflation hit 4.3% in September, which makes an RBA rate rise on Melbourne Cup Day (3 November) close to a sure thing.
Israel's election has ended without a clear winner, with exit polls showing neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition reaching a 61 seat majority.
Israelis vote today in an election that polls say could leave neither side with a majority.
Lula has won a record fourth term as Brazil's president, but Flávio Bolsonaro is refusing to concede and plans to challenge the result.
Brazil picks its president today in a runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro that polls call a coin flip.
